title: Prepare Site for TVC-governed HIL intake projection
coordination_rule: TVC retains exclusive deployment, protected-value consumption, execution-grant issuance, revocation, and runtime authority. Site assistance is non-authorizing and limited to sanitized projection, validation, and public-state boundaries.
remaining_upstream_crossings: protected-value consumption evidence without value disclosure
authoritative positive and negative proof-suite receipts
activation gate evaluation against authentic runtime evidence
site_parallel_safe_work: Verify hil-direct-ingress-worker.yml exists and remains the exact bound workflow
Verify incoming/hil source-object handling is fail-closed
Prepare sanitized execution-grant, consumption, revocation, and runtime receipt import contracts
Require commit-pinned source objects and exact receipt hashes for every imported TVC result
Reject disclosed protected values, scope expansion, invalid signatures, expired grants, replayed consumption, and contradictory revocation states
Validate durable ingress receipts separately from participant-device fallback records
Keep public readiness false until deployment, executor, proof-suite, and runtime-chain evidence all validate
Preserve unrelated Site routes and deployments
coordination_checkpoints: bounded executor consumes one valid grant exactly once
positive and negative proof-suite receipts are retained
Site receives sanitized intake, execution, revocation, and custody projections
public readiness remains false until authentic TVC evidence is imported
acceptance_criteria: Site holds no TV or TVC protected value
worker activation remains bound to authenticated internal intake evidence
receipt projection contains hashes, identities, states, timestamps, scopes, and authority booleans only
participant-device fallback cannot be represented as durable submission
consumed, revoked, expired, unvalidated, replayed, or scope-mismatched grants cannot establish readiness
no public readiness claim occurs before authentic TVC deployment and execution evidence
no Site action grants runtime, execution, publication, release, or custody authority
